prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Introduction Split Layout: Redesign the initial story screen into a split layout showcasing an animated pet mascot reacting on the desktop to immediately set expectations.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet lives right on your desktop screen, reacting to your daily activity and bringing life to your workflow.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:desktop_pet_intro", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Option Time Estimate: Add an explicit time estimate display and helpful hint on the path selection screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Creating your desktop pet takes less than 2 minutes."}}
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Sync Warning Note: Add a prominent hint warning users to sign in with their main account to lock in pet data and prevent accidental pet resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account to keep your pet save file synchronized safely."}}
3: [sign_in, layout] Compact Sign In Screen Layout: Reframe the sign-in screen using a compact layout focus to reduce visual clutter and prevent sign-in stalling.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Save Your Companion Progress", "body": "Log in to safely pair your pet traits and account data."}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Naming and Personality Setup Screen: Introduce a brand new pet setup screen after choosing a pet where users configure the pet's name and primary mood.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"show_progress": true}, "new_pet_naming": {"headline": "Name Your New Friend", "body": "Give your desktop pet a unique name and pick their personality.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "text": "Pet Name", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Personality", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_naming", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Guidelines & Requirements Hint: Display a explicit quality hint and step counter on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing rules.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload well-lit photos showing a clear face for accurate AI pet generation.", "show_step_counter": true}}
6: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Flow: Transform the adoption certificate step into a stage layout complete with confirmation checklist components.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Review your pet details and stamp the official adoption agreement.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Verify Pet Identity", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Registered Desktop Pet", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Status Notification Switch: Turn on ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when their pet successfully renders on the desktop screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Habitat", "body": "We are setting up your pet on your desktop screen. We will notify you when it appears."}}
8: [home, new_screen] Desktop Preparation Progress Screen: Add a dedicated desktop environment initialization screen with dynamic progress bar while waiting for asset generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}, "new_prep_status": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet", "body": "Configuring overlay permissions and loading pet graphics...", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Loading desktop components...", "style": "emphasis"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_prep_status", "home_intro"]}
9: [finish, hint] Quick Control Tips on Welcome Intro: Add clear guidance hints directly on home_intro explaining basic mouse shortcuts to interact with or minimize the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, minimize, or feed it!", "show_step_counter": false}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns story screen while preserving its core job of introducing the pet.
Adds path selection time estimate and hint without altering pricing or core screen job.
Adds account persistence hint to sign-in screen without violating dark pattern rules.
Redesigns sign-in screen into a compact layout while maintaining required functionality.
Introduces new pet naming step inside onboarding flow while retaining all required steps.
Adds photo upload framing guidelines and step counter within onboarding limits.
Adoption certificate components replace the required official stamp with a badge.
Adds ready notification setting on waiting screen while keeping pet creation status.
Adds initialization progress screen to waiting flow without skipping required steps.
Adds shortcut control tips to home intro overlay within onboarding bounds.
